text:
| Layer | Technology | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Language / runtime | Rust 1.98.1, pinned exactly by `rust-toolchain.toml` (rustfmt + clippy); workspace `rust-version = "1.96"`, edition 2024 | One native binary `viola` / `viola.exe`. 1.96 is the declared floor (the security toolchain floor; sysinfo 0.39.6 needs 1.95, std `File::lock` 1.89, rmcp 1.88). CI checks the floor in the `msrv` job: 1.96 is installed by `rustup toolchain install 1.96` and selected with `RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.96`, which outranks `rust-toolchain.toml`, so the pin is untouched. The separate `fuzz/` workspace alone builds on `nightly-2026-09-20`, pinned by `fuzz/rust-toolchain.toml` |

subject: stack
text: | Backend framework (concurrency model) | Hybrid: std threads for `run`, `hook`, `send`, `wait` and every other CLI verb; Tokio 1.53.3 built only inside `mcp` | No async runtime on the hot `hook` path. The async ecosystem is used only where rmcp requires it |

subject: stack
text: | PTY layer | portable-pty `=0.8.1` (pinned) behind viola's own `pty` seam; windows-sys 0.61.2 for the `TerminateProcess` kill fallback, the host console's raw/VT modes (`Win32_System_Console`) and its input read (`ReadConsoleW`, behind `viola_pty::host_stdin()`); libc `=0.2.189` (Unix only) for the host tty's raw mode — both behind `HostTerminal`; windows-sys also restricts every `viola` process's DLL search to System32 (`SetDefaultDllDirectories`) and pre-loads the sideloaded `conpty.dll` by absolute path (`LoadLibraryExW`, `Win32_System_LibraryLoader`). On Windows x64 the ConPTY host is Microsoft's `Microsoft.Windows.Console.ConPTY` 1.24.260710001 (`conpty.dll` + `OpenConsole.exe`, MIT), a vendored non-crate binary pair under `vendor/conpty/`, embedded in `viola` | Hosts the unmodified `claude` in the sideloaded ConPTY (Windows x64; the inbox ConPTY is the fail-open fallback and the host on other Windows targets) or openpty (Unix) |

subject: stack
text: | Database | None. ndjson append logs + atomically replaced JSON snapshots on the local filesystem | Authoritative audit trail and mutable state (wheel mirror, links, budget readings) |

subject: stack
text: | State-file primitives | tempfile 3.27.0 `persist` through one shared helper (`viola_state::fs::replace_private`: the mode is set on the temp file before the write, then `sync_all` and `persist`) for snapshots and every other replaced file; std `File::lock` on separate `.lock` files, opened for write (Windows refuses an exclusive lock on an append-only handle); std `OpenOptions::append` (one `write` per line); the strict-modes check and private-dir creation through libc (Unix modes and owner) and windows-sys (owner + DACL, and the protected user + SYSTEM DACL on a home created outside the user's profile, `Win32_UI_Shell` `GetUserProfileDirectoryW`; a DACL that cannot be set fails the creation) | Crash-safe multi-process writes with no C code |

subject: stack
text: | Content hash | sha2 `=0.11.0` (`default-features = false`; pure Rust, no `cc`) | SHA-256 of the exe bytes, truncated to the first 8 bytes (16 hex), for the `bin/` and `plugin/` `<version>-<hash>` keys, and to re-hash an existing pinned copy (read in 64 KiB chunks) before every reuse; on Windows x64 also the full SHA-256 of each held ConPTY companion against its compiled pin (`viola_state::pin::pin_companions`). A product dependency of `viola-state`; the root dev-dependency stays for its known-answer test (`tests/contract_content_hash.rs`). `[profile.dev.package.sha2] opt-level = 3`, so dev and test builds hash the debug exe at release speed |

subject: stack
text: | Error types | thiserror 2.0.20 (per crate; `viola-pty`'s `PtyError` is hand-written); anyhow 1.0.104 (bin edge only) | Typed errors that callers can branch on; context chains built at dispatch and recorded only in the owner-only instance detail file |

subject: stack
text: | Container runtime / deployment | None. `cargo install --path .`; Claude Code plugin compiled into the binary (`include_str!`) and written out by `viola run` | Local-only v1, no hosting |

text: | CI/CD | GitHub Actions matrix `windows-2025`, `macos-latest` (macOS 26), `ubuntu-latest`; toolchains installed by `rustup toolchain install`: from `rust-toolchain.toml`, from `fuzz/rust-toolchain.toml` in the fuzz jobs, and `1.96` in the `msrv` job (no toolchain action); SHA-pinned actions/checkout 7.0.1, Swatinem/rust-cache 2.9.2, taiki-e/install-action 2.87.19, actions/upload-artifact 7.0.1 | Build, lint and test on all three OSes against the fake agent, on native runners. Before the operator push, the local `viola-harness pre-push` gate runs the ubuntu test job's suites natively on the Linux dev host, in the working tree itself (no clone), every child through `/usr/bin/env -i HOME=<passwd home> PATH=<home>/.cargo/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin`; it refuses `pre-push-linux-only` off Linux, and its `tools` stage checks `cc`, the `rust-toolchain.toml` channel and ci.yml's `test`-job pins (it installs nothing) — a pre-push filter, never the verdict of record |

text: | Code quality | rustfmt, clippy (`-D warnings`, with the workspace `print_stdout` / `print_stderr` / `dbg_macro` bans and `clippy.toml` `disallowed-macros` on the tracing level macros), `cargo check`; ripgrep 15.2.0 (PCRE2; the obs G1/G3 gate tool, installed by `scripts/install-ripgrep.sh`); `jq` (runner-provided: G2's `scripts/g2-zero-panics.sh`, `scripts/release-check.sh` and `scripts/orphans-check.sh`, which refuse with `tool-missing: jq`); hyperfine 1.20.0 (the perf rows' timing runner behind `run --perf`, `-N --warmup 3 --runs 30`; `cargo install --locked` in the CI `perf` job and on the dev host, no lockfile resolves it, as measured on the Windows dev host at chunk 2026-09-28-hook-perf-gate `evidence/hyperfine-host.md`); jsonschema 0.57.0 (test harness `schema-check`, G4); syn `=2.0.119` (`default-features = false`; features `full`, `parsing`, `printing`, `visit`) and proc-macro2 `=1.0.107` (feature `span-locations`), direct dependencies of the test-only `viola-e2e` alone (the `#[cfg]` reader behind `run --mutants`' host exclusion, `harness::run::mutants::host`; no product crate depends on either); cargo-deny 0.20.2 (advisories, licences, sources, bans: C crates, telemetry crates, feature bans; the tokio ban via `deny-sync.toml` per sync crate); zizmor 1.30.1 (GitHub workflow linter); cargo-modules 0.27.0 (`cargo install --locked` in the `lint` job; the orphans gate per lib/bin target in CI, the dependency-graph review on demand); cargo-llvm-cov 0.9.1 with the rustup component `llvm-tools-preview` (the coverage runner behind `run --coverage`; `viola-harness gate` enforces the per-OS floors); cargo-fuzz 0.13.2 (CI-only, `cargo install --locked` in the fuzz jobs), whose `fuzz/` workspace pins libfuzzer-sys `=0.4.13` and arbitrary `=1.4.2` in its own lockfile, outside the root `cargo deny` graph (a test-only exemption, see Build system) | Lint, typecheck, dependency policy, workflow lint, boundary review, coverage, fuzzing |
